about: Propeller moonlets and the sub-km texture (src/rings/propellers.ts, ringTexture.ts): views matched to Cassini propeller images -- PIA12790 (Earhart, lit face, 81 deg below the ring plane, phase 82 deg, 2 km/px, 2008-04-11), PIA12791 (Santos-Dumont, unlit face, 45 deg above, phase 121 deg, 2 km/px, 2008-08-19), Tiscareno et al. 2010 Fig. 1b (Bleriot, lit face, ~70 deg below, phase ~75 deg, ~2 km/px, 2008-04-12), PIA07792 (belt propellers at Saturn orbit insertion 2004-07-01, 52 m/px; a dr ~ 0.3 km belt propeller, unlit face) -- each also without propellers (propellers.scale = 0) for the A/B. The first shot defines window.__pv(o): time o.t, target = a named giant (o.giant) or the largest belt propeller of class >= o.cls near (o.rKm, o.lonDeg), camera o.elDeg above (+) / below (-) the ring plane at the azimuth that gives phase angle o.phaseDeg, o.kmPerPx at the 1600x900 viewport (fov from the distance; bypasses the 20 deg UI minimum). Then the propeller presets and texture views. Usage: node scripts/shots.mjs scripts/test/specs/propellers.json <outDir> --w 1600 --h 900

shots.name: earhart-pia12790
shots.eval: (() => { window.__pv = async (o) => { const sv = window.__sv, D = Math.PI / 180; const frames = (n) => new Promise((r) => { let k = 0; const st = () => (++k >= n ? r() : requestAnimationFrame(st)); requestAnimationFrame(st); }); sv.setTime(o.t); await frames(3); const P = sv.pipeline.ctx.structure.propellers; let a, th, name; if (o.giant) { const g = P.giant(o.giant); a = g.a; th = g.theta; name = g.name; } else { const m = P.findLargest(o.rKm * 1e3, o.lonDeg * D, 400e3, 3000e3, o.cls ?? 1); a = m.a; th = m.theta; name = m.key; } const s = sv.frame.sunDir; const sx = Math.cos(th) * s.x + Math.sin(th) * s.y, sy = -Math.sin(th) * s.x + Math.cos(th) * s.y, sz = s.z; const ce = Math.cos(o.elDeg * D), se = Math.sin(o.elDeg * D), sh = Math.hypot(sx, sy); const cd = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (Math.cos(o.phaseDeg * D) - se * sz) / Math.max(ce * sh, 1e-9))); const az = Math.atan2(sy, sx) + Math.acos(cd) * (o.azSign ?? 1); const dist = o.distKm * 1e3; const c = [ce * Math.cos(az), ce * Math.sin(az), se]; const { FreeController } = await import('/src/camera/FreeController.ts'); const { RingAnchor } = await import('/src/core/RingAnchor.ts'); const { lookQuat } = await import('/src/camera/math.ts'); const V = sv.frame.camPos.constructor, Q = sv.frame.camQuat.constructor; const local = new V(c[0] * dist, c[1] * dist, c[2] * dist); const fwd = local.clone().multiplyScalar(-1); const up = Math.abs(se) > 0.95 ? new V(0, 1, 0) : new V(0, 0, Math.sign(se) || 1); const q = lookQuat(fwd, up, new Q()); const ctl = new FreeController({ frame: 'ring', anchor: new RingAnchor(a, th, sv.frame.t), local, qLocal: q, upLocal: up, speed: 1000 }); sv.camera.goto(sv.frame, ctl, 'propeller view', true); const pa = (o.kmPerPx * 1e3) / dist; sv.app.settings.fovDeg = 2 * Math.atan(450 * pa) / D; if (o.off) P.scale = 0; else P.scale = 1; await frames(6); return name + ' ' + o.t + ' a ' + (a / 1e3).toFixed(2) + ' km lon ' + (th / D).toFixed(3) + ' fov ' + sv.app.settings.fovDeg.toFixed(3) + ' sunEl ' + (Math.asin(sz) / D).toFixed(2); }; return window.__pv({ giant: 'Earhart', t: '2008-04-11T12:00:00Z', elDeg: -81, phaseDeg: 82, distKm: 30000, kmPerPx: 2 }); })()
